rationale: The agent verified identity via the provided email, matched to a single user, and accessed only that user’s orders. It retrieved both orders’ details to identify the bookshelf, confirmed intent before any modification, checked product availability via the product tool, and correctly reported that the 4-ft glass/white variant was unavailable. When the user opted to cancel the entire order if the change wasn’t possible, the agent explicitly stated the exact action and requested confirmation before performing a write. After receiving “Yes,” it executed the cancellation on the correct pending order, and the tool confirmed the status as cancelled with a refund to the same gift card. The final confirmation reflected the tool results accurately, including the refund amount. No unsupported claims or policy violations are evident.
